overview: You gave them one sonnet between them, and it opens on his unworthy hand and her holy shrine. Above it you noted serving-men, napkins, and joint-stools, for whoever is a servant that day. You did not write another man's line into the margin.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the opening, and the note above it.

assets.name: Romeo and Juliet
assets.disposition: Wrote the opening and the servants above it
